title: FIU women's tennis team defeats Boston University 4-1 - South Miami-Dade News
text:
FIU’s women’s tennis team defeated Boston University 4-1 on March 10 at the PayCargo Tennis Center.
The match saw FIU secure the doubles point and singles victories at the No. 1, No. 2, and No. 5 positions to clinch the win. The Panthers improved their season record to 3-4 with this result.
In doubles play, Katerina Mandelikova and Viktorie Hazmukova won their match at No. 1 with a score of 6-3. Maria Lucia Araoz-Gosn and Vittoria Baccino also posted a 6-3 victory at No. 3 doubles, securing the opening point for FIU. The second doubles pair of Jelena Vico and Aleksandra Simeva held a lead when the doubles point was decided.
Mandelikova continued her strong performance in singles, winning at No. 1 by a score of 6-2, 6-1. Araoz-Gosn added another point for FIU with a straight sets win at No. 5 singles, finishing 6-4, 6-2. Boston University earned its only point on Court 4 before Vico sealed the overall victory for FIU with a win at No. 2 singles, ending her match at 6-4, 6-3.
The Panthers are scheduled to return to action against Yale on Wednesday, March 11 at noon.
